func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- web/assets.go --
package web

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/assets"
)

//fabrik:assets
//go:embed all:assets
var Assets embed.FS

//fabrik:config assets
type AssetsConfig = assets.Options

//fabrik:hook setup
func AnnounceAssets(_ context.Context, c *assets.Options) error {
	fmt.Println("assets:", c.Kind)
	return nil
}
-- web/assets/app.css --
body {}
-- web/web.go --
package web

import "net/http"

//fabrik:http GET /{$}
func Home(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/assets"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/config"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"

	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	ctx := context.Background()
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Config
		fabrikEnv := os.Getenv("FABRIK_ENV")
		switch fabrikEnv {
		case "development", "production":
		default:
			if fabrikEnv == "" {
				err = fmt.Errorf("FABRIK_ENV is required: development or production")
			} else {
				err = fmt.Errorf("invalid FABRIK_ENV %q: want development or production", fabrikEnv)
			}
		}
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		configOpts := []config.Option{
			config.FileOptional("config.yaml"),
			config.File("config." + fabrikEnv + ".yaml"),
		}
		if fabrikEnv == "development" {
			configOpts = append(configOpts, config.FileOptional("config.local.yaml"))
		}
		configOpts = append(configOpts, config.KnownSections("assets"))
		assetsOptions, err := config.Load[assets.Options](append(configOpts,
			config.Section("assets"),
		)...)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		// Wire hooks: config exists, providers do not
		if err := web.AnnounceAssets(ctx, assetsOptions); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		// Providers
		r := router.New()
		assetKind, err := assetsOptions.Mode()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var assetServer assets.Server
		switch assetKind {
		case assets.KindSource:
			assetServer, err = assets.NewSource([]assets.Root{
				{FS: os.DirFS("web/assets")},
			}, nil)
		case assets.KindCompiled:
			assetServer, err = assets.Build([]assets.Root{
				{FS: web.Assets, Dir: "assets"},
			}, nil)
		}
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}

		// Register
		r.Handle("/assets/", assetServer.Handler())
		r.Method("GET", "/{$}", web.Home)
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
